status: PARTIAL. The per-view OR placement-index SELECTION for maze-corridor (zone0, facing0) is captured BYTE-EXACT and reproducible (30 OR indices, stable across fresh boots). The OR-blit branch is fully cracked (ega.drv FUN_0a93 0xaa9). A SECOND blit branch — the MASKED branch (0xbc6), a horizontal-MIRROR blit using the cs:[0x192] bit-reverse LUT with a per-call OR-merge/REPLACE flag — is IDENTIFIED at the asm level (branch condition, LUT confirmed = exact 8-bit reverse table, the REPLACE-carves-the-corridor-void mechanism, the call list + flags) but its exact masked SOURCE-PIXEL ALIGNMENT is NOT yet byte-exact, and its capture has a ~1-call ordering instability. From-asset compose with OR-only = 58.09% of the viewport; with the (mis-aligned) masked model = ~50%. The existing 100% gate (engine-composed page) is UNCHANGED and green; this finding adds the SELECTION + the branch RE, not a from-asset byte-exact gate.

findings.claim: The maze background OR-blit (ega.drv FUN_0a93, file 0xa93) is called ONCE PER PLACEMENT. The placement index is arg [bp+0xc] (asm 0xaaa: `mov bx,[bp+0xc]; mov ax,5; mul bx; add ax,cs:[0x190]; mov si,ax` -> si = placement record). The branch arg [bp+0x10] selects the blit MODE: ==0xffff -> the OR branch (0xaa9, single-image forward OR-blit of placement [bp+0xc]); !=0xffff -> the MASKED branch (0xbc6). The 30 OR placement indices the engine emits for maze-corridor (in order) are: [361, 349, 355, 346, 352, 358, 122, 150, 15, 19, 123, 151, 16, 20, 124, 152, 136, 164, 140, 168, 125, 153, 133, 161, 137, 165, 141, 169, 145, 173]. These map (via the live placement+descriptor tables, byte-identical to the offline expandMazeData(mazedata.ega) records) to: ceiling (122/img44), floor-strips, side panels (15/19 = img3/img7, w4 h112), portcullis-window pieces, and the destRow-7 top strips (361/349/.. = img148/img136 w2 h16). The OR placement RECORDS are byte-exact (verified: live idx 122 = img44@(11,32) bias0 count18 seg+0x822 srcOffLow0xb w18 h7 == expandMazeData).

evidence.details: Capstone ega.drv 0xa93..0xac5: 0xa9e `mov ax,[bp+0x10]`; 0xaa1 `cmp ax,0xffff`; 0xaa4 je 0xaa9 (OR branch) else 0xaa6 jmp 0xbc6 (masked). OR branch 0xaaa `mov bx,[bp+0xc]` -> placement idx. Capture: trace-maze.ts `placements` traces ega.drv (relocated base 0x6ba10) 0xaa1/0xaad/0xbca over the settled CLEAN_STATE forceRedraw; the OR-branch arg0c stream (30 indices) is reproducible across fresh boots (the OR block is stable; the masked block has a ~1-call ordering instability — see concerns).

findings.claim: FUN_0a93 has a SECOND branch — the MASKED branch (file 0xbc6) — taken when arg [bp+0x10] != 0xffff. It is a TWO-INDEX, horizontal-MIRROR blit: [bp+0xc] = the SOURCE image (its placement's image descriptor), [bp+0x10] = the DEST placement (geometry + per-row count). It reads the source row BACKWARD (`mov al,[si]; dec si`) and translates each byte through a `cs: xlatb` LUT at CS:[0x192] (the `2e d7` CS-override at file 0xc69) — the LUT was captured live and is the EXACT 8-bit-reverse table (00->00, 01->80, 02->40, 03->c0, ...), so the combined effect is a HORIZONTAL MIRROR of the source sub-image. A per-call flag [bp+0xe] selects OR-merge (0xc66 branch, `or al,es:[di]; stosb`) vs REPLACE (0xcc3 branch, plain `stosb`). 4 planes at di+0/0x2000/0x4000/0x6000, source plane stride = S.w*S.h. For maze-corridor the first full compose pass emits 30 masked calls (18 OR-merge mirror pieces for the perspective ceiling/floor/side strips, then 12 REPLACE pieces that CARVE the receding-corridor void — placements 23..34 — 8 before the OR block and 4 after), THEN the 30 OR calls. The masked REPLACE (flag 0) overwriting with the mirrored void texture is the mechanism that makes the corridor opening BLACK (the engine viewport is all-zero down the center; OR-only over-fills it).

evidence.details: Capstone ega.drv 0xbc6..0xd2e: 0xbc7 bx=[bp+0xc]*5+cs:[0x190] -> [bp-2]=src image desc; 0xbf0 si=[bp+0x10]*5+cs:[0x190] -> dest placement; 0xc01 al=[si+4]=dest.count -> [bp-4]; 0xc0e di=dest.destX+dest.bias; 0xc1b di += dest.destRow*0x28; 0xc24 bx=[bp-2]; cx=[bx+3]=S.w; 0xc39 [bp-2]=S.w*S.h (plane stride); 0xc3e ax=S.srcOffLow; 0xc43-47 += (S.w-1); 0xc49-4c -= dest.bias; 0xc50 ds += S.segDelta; 0xc54 bx=0x192; 0xc5f cmp [bp+0xe],0 (je 0xcc3=REPLACE else OR); 0xc66 `mov al,[si]; dec si; cs: xlatb; or al,es:[di]; stosb` x4 planes; 0xd14 di+=0x28; 0xd18 src row += S.w. LUT captured at CS:[0x192] (cs<<4+0x192) = exact bit-reverse table (verified all 256). Per-call [bp+0xe] flags for the 30-masked block (in order): 18x 1(OR), then 8x 0(REPLACE), then [after OR block] 4x 0(REPLACE).

findings.claim: The masked branch's exact masked SOURCE-PIXEL alignment is NOT yet byte-exact. The model `dest_byte[b] = bitrev(src_byte_read_backward_from (S.srcOffLow + S.w-1 - dest.bias))` reproduces the right STRUCTURE but over-sets/mis-aligns: a sweep of the source-start delta (-4..+4), forward-vs-backward byte read, and the dest-bias term never exceeds ~51% of the viewport (vs 58% for OR-only — i.e. the masked model currently HURTS). A decisive single-byte check at the ceiling left edge (page byte 11, y32, plane0) shows the engine's masked contribution there is exactly `bitrev(src_byte[0]) = e0` (engine `e7` = OR `07` | masked `e0`) — i.e. dest[0] = bitrev(src[0]), a FORWARD byte read with bit-reverse, NOT the backward read the `dec si` asm implies. But applying forward-bitrev across the full dest.count width OVER-sets the interior bytes (byte 12 wants masked-contribution 0 but forward-bitrev adds bitrev(src[1])). This means the masked per-row COUNT (or the source sub-image) is NARROWER than dest.count, OR the masked source is a different (perspective-edge) sub-image than arg0c's full image descriptor. Unresolved this pass.

evidence.details: tools/parity/validate-placement-selection.ts (DIAGNOSTIC): OR-only=58.09%, OR+masked(backward,bitrev,dp.count)=48.5%, OR+masked(forward,bitrev,dp.count)=49.6%, source-start delta sweep -4..+4 peak=51.2%. Ceiling left-edge check (tools/parity/validate-placement-selection.ts + ad-hoc): engine page byte11 y32 p0 = e7; OR(122) contributes 07; masked must add e0; bitrev(img44 src[0]=07)=e0 (forward), bitrev(read backward from byte17=58)=1a (does NOT match). So forward-bitrev is right at b=0 but the width/source must differ for b>0. Needs a deeper masked-source RE (likely the masked uses a perspective-cropped count, not dest.count).
